summary: A 121-foot Aermotor lookout built in 1936 on the Fort Apache-White Mountain Indian Reservation, listed as standing; its history in the 2002 Rodeo-Chediski Fire is undocumented.

facts.design: 121-foot Aermotor lookout; an original log groundhouse is preserved on the site

staffing.status: described as in active service; staffing not stated

access.note: On the Fort Apache-White Mountain Indian Reservation, administered by the White Mountain Apache Agency; the register gives no public visiting information.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register puts the lookout site at 6,573 ft (2,003 m); Wikipedia gives the peak 7,462 ft. The two figures probably describe different points. The record keeps the register's figure for the tower and the story uses the peak figure only for the peak.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 build date and the 121-foot height come from the register alone. No source found names the builder, and the sources checked do not say whether the tower was damaged or spared in the 2002 Rodeo-Chediski Fire, so that gap is left open in the story. Coordinates disagree: the register gives 34.1361, -110.723044 and the Arizona list gives 34.18336, -110.66383, roughly 7 km apart. The record keeps the register point; the editor should check which is right. The brief flags a shared register number; the two sources checked both give US 202, AZ 9 for Chediski, and no other tower with that number turned up in the pages read. Two leads were not used because the pages could not be read: a firelookout.org Arizona key page returned 404 and a hikearizona trip report returned 403. Search snippets claimed a 7x7 foot cab, a Semi-Active status in an older database, and a 2014 closed-for-season visit; none is verified, so none is in the story. The register's active-service line is undated.
